name: com.theindependentai/mcp
title: The Independent AI
description: Independent checks of viral AI claims, reviewed AI tools and daily AI news. Read-only, no sign-in.

tools.name: today
tools.description: The Independent AI's daily digest: the three lead news briefings (The day in 3), the three newest Hype or Fact? verdicts, the newest Worth testing pick and tools added to the reviewed directory this week, each with a link. No input.

tools.name: brief_me
tools.description: Everything The Independent AI has published on one topic: up to 3 news items, 3 Hype or Fact? checks with verdicts, 3 reviewed tools, a Worth testing write-up and matching guides, each with a link.

topic.description: The topic, in plain words (up to 200 characters).

tools.name: search_checks
tools.description: Search Hype or Fact?, The Independent AI's published checks of viral AI claims. With a query, returns the best-matching checks (up to 5); without one, the newest checks. Each result has the verdict (Fact, Partly fact or Hype), a one-line summary, who made the claim, the date checked and a link. Quote the verdict with its caveats and cite the individual check link.

query.description: The claim or keywords to look up, in plain words (up to 200 characters).

verdict.description: Only return checks with this verdict.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Read or search The Independent AI's news. 'latest' is the sourced news briefings; 'community' is the editors' Community picks. Without a query, returns the newest stories (up to 8); with one, the best matches. Each story has its date, a one-line summary where available and a link.

query.description: Keywords to search for (up to 200 characters). Omit for the newest stories.

tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Find AI tools for a task in The Independent AI's reviewed directory, best match first (up to 5), with the editorial rating (Essential, Worth a look or Niche), price label, one-line review, date checked and link, plus matching Worth testing write-ups.

task.description: What the tool is for, in plain words (up to 200 characters).

filter.description: Only tools with this rating, or only tools that are free to start.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search everything The Independent AI publishes (Hype or Fact? checks, news, Worth testing and reviewed tools), best match first. Returns ids, titles and links; pass an id to fetch for the full entry.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one entry from The Independent AI in full, by the id search returned or its theindependentai.com link: a check with its verdict, evidence and sources; a tool review; a Worth testing write-up; a Community pick; a guide; or a news briefing's title and standfirst.

id.description: An id from search, or a theindependentai.com link.

tools.name: start_build
tools.description: A starter outline for building something with AI in a business, assembled from The Independent AI's published coverage: up to 5 reviewed tools, Worth testing write-ups, the Hype or Fact? checks worth knowing first and related news, each with a link. When the goal matches nothing, it falls back to coverage for the business type. The result ends with next steps; the last is a labelled, disclosed note from the site's publisher.

goal.description: What to build, in plain words (up to 300 characters). No names or contact details.

business_type.description: The kind of business, e.g. 'dental clinic' (up to 100 characters).

capabilities.description: Up to 5 short phrases naming what the build must do, e.g. 'appointment booking', 'website chat'. Matched against reviewed tools; a capability with no reviewed tool is reported as not yet covered.
